long_biography.plain_text:
An industrial partnership with MSC offered Stefano Messina and his relatives a way to strengthen their shipping company while retaining control. He participated in negotiations with the company’s bank as the agreement developed. MSC’s Italian holding company, Marinvest, subsequently became a shareholder, leaving the Messina group with a majority interest.

Messina studied law at the University of Genoa and spent a year at a London bank before joining the family companies in 1994. Inside the shipping group, he took responsibility for planning, administration, finance and management control. He also chaired Yarpa, a private equity business.
